visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a medium shot of a young man with grey-white hair (Ah Xiang) sitting in an office chair against a white wall, smiling and speaking directly to the camera. He is wearing a grey athletic shirt. (2) A young woman (Rou Yi) in a grey Snoopy t-shirt appears behind him and begins applying baby oil to his forehead and ears using a white cotton pad. The background shows an indoor home setting with a wooden doorway. (3) A brief cutaway shows a car interior where the man sits next to an older man driving, showing similar grey hair patterns. (4) Back in the room, the man has changed into a blue t-shirt with the AVIDER logo. The woman holds a white squeeze bottle of hair dye and applies it directly onto his head while he talks and reacts with surprise. (5) The woman continues applying and spreading the dye, which appears as a light greenish-white paste initially. The man has some dye spots on his skin. They engage in playful dialogue with various animated text overlays appearing. (6) A close-up shot of a chrome shower head spraying water against a blurred background serves as a transition. (7) Post-shower, the man sits with wet, dark hair. The woman inspects the result with her hands, looking satisfied while the man questions the final color. (8) The video ends with a close-up of the couple's faces as they joke about the dye color, with the man expressing playful disbelief.
